figurative_meaning_en: The garland given by the bride to the groom
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিয়ের মণ্ডপে বধূ সংকোচের সাথে বরমাল্য পরিয়ে দিল।
বরমাল্য গ্রহণ করে বর বধূকে স্বাগত জানাল।
example_sentences_in_english: In the wedding pavilion, the bride shyly placed the garland on the groom.
The groom accepted the garland and welcomed the bride.
history: This idiom refers to a traditional practice in Bengali Hindu weddings where the bride garlands the groom as a symbol of acceptance and union.
note: Primarily used in the context of wedding rituals, symbolizing marital consent.
